SaSAdaH pfTivImimAm । prAptaH paramaDarmmAtmA so'yoDyAyAM nfpo'Bavat । SaSAdasya tu dAyAdaH kakutsTo nAma vIryyavAn । anenAScApi kAkutsTaH pfDuScAnenasaH sutaH । vizvagaSvaH pfToH putrastasmAdadriSca jajYivAn । adreSca yuvanASvastu SrAvastasyAtmajo'Bavat । tasya SrAvastakojYeyaH SrAvastI yena nirmmitA । SrAvastasya tu dAyAdo vfhadaSvo mahAbalaH । vfhadaSvasya dAyAdaH kubalASva iti smftaH । kubalaHSvasya putrARAM sahasrARyekaviMSatiH । sarve vidyAsu nizRAtA balavantaH sudAruRAH । kubalASvaSca pitfto guREraByaDiko'Bavat । samaye taM pitA rAjye vfhadaSvo'Byazecayat । kubalASvaM mahArAja । SUramuttamaDArmmikam । putrasaMkrAmitaSrIstu vfhadaSvo mahIpatiH । jagAma tapase DImAMstapovanamamitrahA” । ityupakramya maDukEwaBayoHsamutpattibaDakaTAnte 203 a॰ “mArkaRqeyOvAca । DunDurnAma mahArAja! tayoH putroHmahAdyutiH । sa tapo'tapyata mahat mahAvIryyaparAkramaH । atizWadekapAdena kfSo DamanisantataH । tasmE brahmA dadO prIto varaM vavre sa ca praBum । devadAnavayakzARAM sarpaganDarvarakzasAm । abaDyo'haM BaveyaM vE vara eza vfto mayA । evaM Bavatu gacCeti tamuvAca pitAmahaH । sa evamuktastatpAdO mUrdDnA''spfSya jagAma ha । sa tu DunDurvaraM labDvA mahAvIryyaparAkramaH । anusmaran pitfbaDaM drutaM vizRumupAgamat । sa tu devAn saganDarvAn jitvA DunDuramarzaRaH । babADe sarvAnasakfdvizRuM devAMSca vE BfSam । samudre bAlukApUrRe ujjAlaka iti smfte । Agamya ca sa duzwAtmA taM deSaM BaratarSaBa! । vADate sma paraM SaktyA tamutaNkASramaM viBo! । antarBU migatastatra bAlukAntarhitastaTA । maDukEwaBayoH putro DunDurBImaparAkramaH । Sete lokavinASAya tapobalamupASritaH । utaNkasyASramAByAse niHSvasan pAvakArccizaH । etasminneva kAle tu rAjA savalavAhanaH । utaNkaviprasahitaH kubalASvo mahIpatiH । putrEH saha mahIpAlaH । prayayO BaratarzaBa! । sahasrErekaviMSatyA putrARAmarimarddanaH । kubalASvo narapatiranvito balaSAlinAm । tamAviSattato vizRurBagavAMstejasA praBuH । utaNkasya niyo gena lokAnAM hitakAsyavA । tasmin prayAte durdDarze divi Sabdo mahAnaBUt । eza SromAnabaDyo'dya DunDumAro Bavizyati । divyESca puzpEstaM devAH samantAt paryyavAkiran । devadundumayaScApi neduH svayamanIritAH । SItaSca vAyuH pravavO prayARe tasya DImataH । vipAMSulAM mahIM kurvan vavarza ca sureSvaraH । antarIkze vimAnAni devatAnAM yuDimira! । tatrEva samavfSyanta DunDuryatra mahAsuraH । kubalASvasya DunDoSca yudDaM kOtUhalAnvitAH । devaganDavasahitAH samavEkzatmaharzayaH । nArAyaRena kOravya! tejasApyAyitastadA । sa gato nrapatiH kzipraM putrEstEH sarvato diSam । arRavaM KAnayAmAsa kubalASvomahIpatiH । kubalASvasya putrESca tasmin vE bAlukArRave । saptaBirddivasEH KAtvA dfzwo DunDurmmahAbalaH । AsIdGoraM vapustasya bAlukAntarhitaM mahat । dIpyamAno yaTA sUryyastejasA BaratarzaBa! । tato DunDurmmahArAja! diSamAvftya paScimAm । supto'BUdrAjaSArddUla! kAlAnalasamadyutiH । kubalASvasya putrEstu sarvataH parivAritaH । aBidrutaH SarEstIkzRErgadABirmmusalErapi । pawwiSEH pariGEH prAsEH KaqgESca vimalEH SitEH । sa baDyamAnaH saMkrudDaH samuttasTO mahAbalaH । krudDaScABakzayattezAM SastrARi viviDAni ca । AsyAdvaman pAvakaM sa saMvarttakasamaM tadA । tAn sarvAnnfpateH putrAnadahat svena tejasA । muKajenAgninA krudDo lokAnudvarttayanniva । kzaRena rAjaSArddUla! pureva kapilaH praBuH । sagarasyAtmajAn krudDastadadButamivABavat । tezu kroDAgnidagDezu tadA Baratasattama! । taM prabudDaM mahAtmAnaM kumBakarRa mivAparam । AsasAda mahAtejAH kubalASvo mahIpatiH । tasya vAri mahArAja! susrAva bahu dehataH । tadApIyata tattejo rAjA vArimayaM nfpa! । yogI yogena vahniYca SamayAmAsa vAriRA । brahmAstreRa ca rAjendra! dEtyaM krUraparAkramam । dadAha BarataSrezWa! sarvalokABayAya vE । so'streRa dagDvA rAjarziH kubalASvo mahAsuram । suraSatrumamitraGnaM trElokyeSEvAparaH । DunDorbaDAttadA rAjA kubalASvo mahAmanAH । DunDumAra iti KyAto nAmnA'pratiraTo'Bavat” ।

a: कुबे(वे)रः — [कुत्सितं बे(वे)रं शरीरं यस्य सः] The god of riches and treasure and the regent of the northern quarter; कुबेरगुप्तां दिशमुष्णरश्मौ गंतुं प्रवृत्ते समयं विलंघ्य Ku. 3. 25 (vide Malli. thereon.). [Kubera is the son of Viśravas by Iḍaviḍā and thus the halfbrother of Rāvaṇa. Besides being the lord of riches and regent of the north, he is the king of the Yakṣas and Kinnaras, and a friend of Rudra. His abode is Kailāsa. He is represented as being deformed in body-having three legs, only eight teeth, and a yellow mark in place of one eye]. --Comp. --अद्रिः. --अचलः an epithet of mountain Kailāsa. --दिश् f. the north.

k.v: कुबेरस्त्र्यम्बकसखो यक्षराड्गुह्यकेश्वरः। मनुष्यधर्मा धनदो राजराजो धनाधिपः॥
कुबेरः ईशः पतयः पूर्वादीनां दिशां क्रमात्. रविः शुक्रो महीसूनुः स्वर्भानुर्भानुजो विधुः। बुधो बृहस्पतिश्चेति दिशां चैव तथा ग्रहाः। ऐरावतः पुण्डरीको वामनः कुमुदोऽञ्जनः॥

a: कुब्ज — a. [कु ईषत् उब्जमार्जंवं यत्र शकं˚ Tv.] Hump-backed, crooked. --ब्जः 1 A curved sword. --2 A hump on the back. --ब्जा A young female servant of Kaṃsa, said to be deformed in three parts of her body. [Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma, while proceeding to Mathurā, saw her on the high road carrying unguent to Kaṃsa. They asked her if she would give them some portion of it, and she gave as much as they wanted. Kṛṣṇa, being very much pleased with her kindness, made her perfectly straight, and she began to appear a most beautiful woman]. --Comp. --किरातंः --वामनं a hump-backed person and a dwarf. --गामिन् a. going crookedly, going astray; Pt. 2. 5. --लीला the manner, gait, or character of a hump-backed person; Ś. 2.
